title: Giovanni Antonio Muscetula (Rome) to Charles V, 24 Oct 1531, AGS Estado leg. 853 doc. 91 (DECODE R9961, R9962)

documents.shelfmark: AGS, Estado, leg. 853, doc. 91 (DECODE R9961; R9962 = its first leaf)
documents.route: Giovanni Antonio Muscetula (imperial agent, Rome) to Charles V

plaintext.source: contemporary decipherment bound as doc. 91 bis (AGS scans 021-023, paragraphs A, b, C, d keyed to the letter's margins); two blocks glossed in the margin (scans 009, 017)

transcription.source: decipherment sheet transcribed from DECODE images; cipher not transcribed

system.summary: Luo Cifrario 22: homophonic sign alphabet with a few code signs (ba = Vuestra Magestad, sign for que, ll); Spanish.
system.notes: Key from Luo 2021 p. 637; not applied letter by letter.

prior_solution.where: contemporary decipherment bound as doc. 91 bis of the same letter

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie to the model, set up Claude Code with Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Grepped Tomokiyo's AGS Estado page: R9962 is a subset of R9961, cipher Lu.22; no decipherment mentioned.
Searched Luo 2021 thesis: Cifrario 22 is Muscetula's key (p. 637); leg. 853 doc. 91 not in her corpus.
Fetched R9962 (4) and R9961 (24) images with the shared cookie.
Viewed every page: scans 021-023 are a decipherment headed 'De Muxetula', paragraphs A, b, C, d; marginal decipherments on 009 and 017.
Paragraph letters match the letter's margin letters; decipherment openings continue the clear text before each block; code sign ba (V. Md.) sits where the decipherment has 'a V. Md.' in block C.

outcome.method_basis: The contemporary decipherment is bound with the letter as AGS Estado leg. 853 doc. 91 bis (DECODE R9961 images 21-23), with marginal decipherments for the two short blocks; no re-decipherment was made with Luo's Cifrario 22.
outcome.notes: Read at the time; decipherment bound as doc. 91 bis. Catalogue entry 203 removed; no write-up.
